preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to deprecate the contract and set a malicious upgradedAddress
Contract must not already be deprecated (deprecated == false)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the deprecate() function with a malicious upgradedAddress that implements the UpgradedStandardToken interface but contains logic that violates ERC721 standards. This will cause the contract to redirect all token operations to the non-conformant implementation, potentially breaking integrations that rely on ERC721 compliance.
